summary.result: The results from this research can be used as a guideline to make policies to stimulate the eco-friendly vehicle industry in Korea.
summary.background: As serious consequences of climate change became indisputable, vehicles based on fossil fuel has to be shifted toward more sustainable way to drastically reduce carbon emissions.
summary.method: In order to achieve this goal, surveys are collected from the professionals of eco-friendly vehicle industry, and analyzed through Delphi method.
